scope: sanitized read-only observation of the user's configured Google Cloud project
method: gcloud describe/list commands; no project, API, IAM, billing or compute mutation
project_identity: redacted; deployment must select and freeze an explicit project

existing_instance_inventory.instance_identifiers: redacted; existing resources are outside campaign ownership

limits_of_observation: Quota is not a reservation or proof of actual regional capacity.
Global, regional and family quotas all constrain dispatch; region limits cannot be added across regions to bypass the global limit.
Zero Spot/preemptible CPU quota blocks a Spot-only strategy unless changed and rechecked.
No exact price/FX quote, benchmark, Batch allocation, Firestore transaction, controller deployment or watchdog trial was performed.
No existing stopped VM, disk or network resource was started, deleted or modified. Stopped compute does not establish zero residual storage charges.
All quotas, enabled services and price/profile inputs must be checked again before paid deployment.
